description: Source code for AndroidGradleTargetBuilder class, which builds Gradle-based Android projects within the IntelliJ IDEA build system.

classes.name: AndroidGradleTargetBuilder
classes.description: Builds Gradle-based Android project using Gradle within IntelliJ IDEA's build system.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Main method to trigger the build process for a given AndroidGradleBuildTarget.

methods.name: checkUnsupportedModules
methods.description: Checks for modules that are not compatible with Gradle build system and issues warnings.

methods.name: getBuildTasks
methods.description: Determines the list of Gradle tasks to execute based on project and build settings.

methods.name: getModulesToBuild
methods.description: Selects modules to build based on project configuration and execution settings.

methods.name: isGradleProject
methods.description: Checks if the project is a Gradle project based on module properties.

methods.name: getAndroidModuleProperties
methods.description: Retrieves Android module properties for a given module.

methods.name: populateBuildTasks
methods.description: Adds appropriate Gradle build tasks for a module based on build mode.

methods.name: getTestCompileType
methods.description: Determines the test compile type based on the current compile context.

methods.name: ensureTempDirExists
methods.description: Ensures the system temporary directory exists for Gradle.

methods.name: getAndroidHomeFromModuleSdk
methods.description: Retrieves Android SDK home path from project modules.

methods.name: getFirstAndroidSdk
methods.description: Finds the first Android SDK associated with the project.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Executes the Gradle build with specified tasks and settings.

methods.name: getGradleConnector
methods.description: Creates and configures a GradleConnector instance based on execution settings.

methods.name: handleBuildException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during Gradle build invocation, parsing output and reporting errors.

methods.name: createCompilerErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates a compiler message of error type with given message.

methods.name: getPresentableName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the builder.
